name: autoclip
description: AutoClip : AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation · 一款智能高光提取与剪辑的二创工具
one_liner: A tool that watches a long video (like a stream or lecture from YouTube or Bilibili) and automatically pulls out the exciting or highlight moments as short clips, ready to post.
buyer: A social media manager for a streamer, coach, or podcaster who currently pays an editor to comb through hours of footage for shareable clips.
business_use_cases: A clipping agency uses it to speed up turning long Twitch/YouTube streams into short-form clips for TikTok and Reels, taking on more clients at the same team size.
A conference or webinar organizer auto-generates highlight reels from hours of recorded talks for marketing use.
A course creator turns long lecture recordings into bite-size highlight clips to promote the full paid course.

money_ideas.idea: Run a 'done for you' clipping service for streamers and podcasters, using this to do the first pass and a human to polish.
Sell one-off highlight-reel packages to event organizers and course creators.

steal_this: Take one local streamer's or podcaster's backlog, run it through AutoClip, and pitch them a week's worth of ready-to-post highlight clips as a paid trial.
